summary: Braskem S.A. filed a Form 6-K on June 15, 2026, announcing the election and re-election of members to its Statutory Compliance and Audit Committee and other Board advisory committees, following the election of a new Board of Directors at an Extraordinary General Meeting held on June 8, 2026. The filing outlines committee compositions with terms until the 2028 Annual General Meeting, and notes the execution of a Shareholders Agreement between Petrobras and Shine I FIP. No financial terms, premiums, or deal values are provided. This is a routine governance update with committee appointments, not a special situation event. No advisors or structural mechanics are mentioned.
